interim_preserved.reason: Exact-institution lookup incorrectly required city-state clarification; fixed before restarting the full run.

release_decision: Improved, but not a production-readiness sign-off: incomplete provider lookup and long search latency remain.
judgment_method: Assistant review against the saved expectation, visible answer and source-validation metadata; not an independent human or clinical sign-off.
limitations: Only 8 targeted questions were rerun on the latest build; the complete 40-question run used 857bc23. Latest-per-question totals combine those phases.
These are synthetic questions in one long conversation, not a fresh-session benchmark or independent clinical review.
PASS means the stated expectation was met; exact-number refusal cases can pass without resolving the lookup.
Published phone/address/service evidence does not verify current admission, pickup, opening hours, or whether a community animal will be accepted.
Provider research remains variable; the corrected Panaji handling question still returned a generic provider fallback.
Automated checks include mocks and controlled concurrency; they are separate from the actual browser UI answers.
No Google/LocationIQ purchase or model migration was performed. A paid geocoder is not demonstrated to resolve these evidence gaps.
Older local health and candidate smoke files are historical phase evidence, not current UI outcomes.
